sentences.en: This is what they have in common with other peoples.
sentences.zh: 他们和其他民族共有这一点。

sentences.en: Barking at strangers is a habit common to many dogs.
sentences.zh: 对着陌生人叫是许多狗的共性。

sentences.en: His bad behavior is a reflection on his common sense.
sentences.zh: 他的不良行为反映了他缺乏常识。

senses.zh: 共同的，公共的； n .平民，普通 ；<衍生词> commonly
